scope: 32 cases: 16 deterministic development source-hash cases plus 16 selected historical baseline failures, reported separately; three repetitions; paired gold/raw paths for owner and envelopes only

conclusions.candidateV3: Quality reference; historical gold-source boundary and handwritten German candidate limits remain
conclusions.canonicalOwner: Rejected tested design: poor membership consistency and grouping
conclusions.envelopes: Generic candidate challenger; improves selected failure sample but no representative win, incomplete multiword recall and larger token/latency cost
conclusions.membershipSupportGate: Uncalibrated; cannot treat selective accuracy at very low coverage as a quick consistent result
conclusions.hybrid: Plumbing smoke only; no production winner or alternative-ranking validation

hybridSmoke.scope: 4 representative IDs, 3 repetitions, gold input only; do not merge into 32-case comparison

languageScope: German-first ambient route language de including Foreign per ADR0045; sourceLang identity is separate and unimplemented
rawSourceVersion: Live owner/envelope pilots use the pre-intact-alternative scanner; revised contextual source plan coverage was audited offline only
